text:
Maria: Heads-up — planning a coordinated deploy in ~2h for a small runtime KV-cache tweak and router header-split change. Need API + Console compatibility sign-off before we roll. Canary strategy: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% with monitoring windows.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window at 1719992222. Steps: canary-5%(15m) -> canary-25%(15m) -> ramp-75%(10m) -> full. Automatic rollback disabled for first canary step (manual vet required).

Alex: quick q: which exact runtime artifact are we shipping? need pin info to update API routing and client-facing headers.

Maria: runtime image: infra/runtime:v2.3.1-kvfix. Router change is header-split:v5 (compatible with v2.3.x). Console: no schema migrations; we will gate the console UI by a feature flag so no release required there. Pin suggestions: pin API routes to runtime v2.3.1 for the rollout window.

Samir: runtime change is mostly an eviction edge-case fix for small prefix caches — should lower p95 gen times for sessions with big KV loads. No model shape changes. I've left a fallback build runtime:v2.3.0-fallback that keeps old eviction logic.

Jen: rollback criteria we agreed on? want to be explicit: p95 latency increase, error spikes, and crashloop counts.

Maria: agreed. Rollback triggers (manual/automated alerts):
- p95 latency > baseline + 30% sustained for 10m
- overall 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m
- crashloop/restarter > 3 new instances in 5m
- console telemetry schema errors > 0.1% (should be 0 but listing for safety)
If any trigger fires during canary, we pause and run quick revert to runtime:v2.3.0-fallback and router header-split roll back to v4.

Alex: can we pin at the router layer only for certain routes if we need partial rollback? e.g., pin /v1/generate to v2.3.0 while letting other routes ride v2.3.1.

Samir: yes, router supports per-route variant pinning. We'll add a temporary route pin rule for /v1/generate if we see degradation concentrated there.

Maria: deployment commands for operators (copyable):
```
# pin runtime for customer scope
deployctl pin runtime --service runtime --version v2.3.1 --scope all --until 2026-03-21T06:00:00Z

# route pin for quick rollback (if needed)
deployctl pin route --path /v1/generate --target-version v2.3.0

# rollback runtime
deployctl rollback runtime --service runtime --to-version v2.3.0-fallback
```

Jen: please add these commands to the runbook and add the metrics dashboards we'll watch. Link console dashboard here: https://console.redwood/test-deploy-metrics (editable)

Maria: done — runbook updated, added a preflight checklist. Key watch panels: p95 latency, 5xx rate, infra restarts, router header-error-rate. Also added a quick sanity prompt set (10 prompts) that Alex will run against canary.

Alex: I'll run the sanity set at each step and post results. If anything looks off I will call for hold and run rollback.

deploy-bot: noted: operator Alex assigned to manual canary vet. On-call Samir will be backup if Alex not available.

Samir: I'll keep an eye on kernel logs during the 5% canary. If kernel fallback warnings appear we should reduce to 0% and roll back.

Jen: minor ask — ensure release notes mention the KV-cache semantics tweak and the router header-split implications for client SDKs. Add a short note for client teams: "no header renames, just routing split; SDKs unaffected unless they rely on header ordering".

Maria: will add release-note blurb and ping client-eng. Also added a tweak to change-window: mark this as a "low-impact" window but keep it inside quiet hours (no other infra changes allowed).

Alex: :thumbsup: ok. schedule looks good. I'll post a short status update at each canary boundary. If we need an emergency rollback, I'll run the command and post the runbook excerpt.

Jen: copying the fallback checklist here for quick access: 1) pin routes to fallback 2) rollback runtime 3) notify client-eng and ops 4) create an incident channel if >30min recovery.

Maria: thanks everyone. final ask: no DB migrations, no console schema flips during this window. If anyone needs to add changes, please escalate now.

Alex: acknowledged. see you in the window.
